title: Solving the Most Common Digital Challenges Faced By IT | HatchWorks AI
description: It cannot be denied: thriving in today’s digital world is no easy feat for IT professionals. No matter the industry they work in or the products, services or audiences they cater to, IT departments tend to share one overarching challenge in common—the inability to take advantage of all the opportunities available through digital product automation and digital product transformation.
